Train a curation selection model using explicit configuration.

Source: R/curation_model.R
curation_train_model.Rd

eval_source = "random" keeps model fitting and out-of-fold evaluation on the unbiased random-review sample. The existing trainer performs unanimous reviewer consensus and retains the established planscanR_selection_model fields and class.

Usage

curation_train_model(
  records,
  reviews,
  config,
  learner = NULL,
  learner_key = NULL,
  eval_source = "random",
  include = character(0),
  v = 5L,
  repeats = 1L,
  threshold = 0.5,
  seed = NULL,
  input_provenance = NULL,
  cohort_receipt = NULL
)

Arguments

records

A scored and classified record data frame.

reviews

Review rows with country, document_id, reviewer_id (or reviewer), decision, source, and reviewed_at.

config

A planscanR_curation_config supplying topics and labels.

learner

Optional existing planscanR_selection_learner.

learner_key

Optional key from selection_learners().

eval_source

Review source(s) used for training and evaluation; defaults to "random", or NULL for all sources.

include

Optional extra feature columns accepted by selection_features().

v, repeats

Cross-validation folds and repeats.

threshold

Probability cutoff stored on the model.

seed

Optional seed passed to the existing trainer.

input_provenance

Optional identity for the explicitly selected scored input snapshot.

cohort_receipt

Optional immutable historical-cohort receipt identity.

Value

A planscanR_selection_model.
